TASK-S6-07: Density as a function, not only a constant - a material or layer may carry rho(x) in the body's frame as data: polynomials (exact cut-cell moments; Ren et al. 2018 and D'Urso & Trotta 2017 closed forms for mesh bodies), and any function - noise (Perlin/simplex/value), integer hash, piecewise, a sampled 3-D texture, sums and products of these - read by per-cell quadrature whose error is bounded against the phase tolerance; deterministic across platforms (integer hashes, no platform transcendental in the noise); oracles: a linearly graded slab and sphere in closed form, mass and moments of a polynomial body exact, quadrature control arm (not started)

TASK-S6-08: Skinned deformation - a body embedded in a cage of tetrahedra, each carrying a fixed mass (mass conserved by construction), the cage driven by a skeleton and skin weights (linear blend and dual-quaternion), each deformed tetrahedron read by its exact polyhedral field near and its affine-mapped moments far; glTF import of skeleton, skin weights and clips; the same elements S7's elastic solids deform; oracles: the rigid limit equals per-bone trees bit for bit, mass constant through every pose, a bent arm converges as the cage refines (not started)

TASK-S6-09: Body orientation and rotation - a body's pose is position plus orientation (unit quaternion) as closed-form functions of time: fixed orientation, spin about an axis, precession and nutation, tumbling, and spin about an offset axis (rotors, fans, turbines, centrifuges, a rotating machine part); the read rotates the body-frame tree exactly (moments rotated as tensors, clipped/exact pieces transformed); the drawn path and the periodogram show the rotation lines; oracles: a spinning axisymmetric body reads constant, a spinning dumbbell gives lines at 2f, an offset rotor at f, voxels fixed in the body vs the world as in the shapes study (docs/research/exact-skin-and-partial-fill.md) (not started)

TASK-S18-13: Review fixes, what is held: the tests section 4 names (K3, K4, K9, E6, T1's 12 events, T2 by typing, C5 through the frame), the ? sheet that fits and scrolls from the keys (R5, R6); a click in a window moves the focus; minor 6; the section 6 budgets measured by the demo (done)

TASK-S20-03: Viewports as a mosaic - layouts as subplot_mosaic-style label grids with weights, any number of viewports, resizable splitters, split/close/swap, pop out and dock (docs/design/workspace.md 1) (done)

TASK-S20-05: The floating tool palette inside the viewport, draggable, with flyouts and an options bar (workspace.md 3) (done)

TASK-S20-06: Top bar, transport buttons (start, step, play/pause, step, end, loop, speed) and the density pass - compact sizes, fields that fill their column, every button with a clear action (workspace.md 0, 4, 5) (done)
TASK-S20-07: Scene tree folders - user folders inside the groups, nest, drag, eye and lock for children, saved with the scene (workspace.md 6) (done)

TASK-S20-08: A body's drawn path follows its motion - a periodic path is drawn over one period with enough pieces per loop (today 96 straight pieces span the whole timeline, so a fast circle is drawn as a square), a path with breaks piece by piece; the plots' sampling checked the same way (done)

TASK-S20-09: Time without an end - the scene's duration editable from the transport (not only the Scene card) and end behaviour chosen there (loop, stop at the end, or run on: the duration grows as one edit); the live rolling mode split off as TASK-S22-01 by the S20 brief (done)

TASK-S20-10: The fly camera as a first-person game camera - pointer captured and hidden while flying (raw mouse deltas; pointer lock on the web), mouse-look yaw and pitch with pitch clamped short of straight up and down and no roll, W A S D along the view with Space up and Shift down, Ctrl (or double-tap W) to sprint and the wheel to change speed, movement integrated per frame with frame time and smooth acceleration (keys held, not key-repeat), sensitivity and speed as settings, entered by holding the right button or a toggle key and left by releasing it or Esc, never firing tool or scope shortcuts while flying; orbit and pan given the same per-frame smoothing (done)

TASK-S20-11: A physical camera - a walk mode with a character controller (a player-sized box with eye height, gravity, jump, step-up over one voxel, sliding along walls) colliding with the voxel world, voxel bodies, floor and room by swept-box tests against occupancy; double-tap Space toggles flying as in a creative-mode game, and the fly camera collides too; in walk mode Space jumps and Shift is free for sneak or slow-walk (not falling off edges), if cheap; noclip is an explicit toggle (off by default) for passing through matter; the camera has no mass and never enters the scene or the gravity read; player size, eye height, walk and fly speeds and jump height as settings (done)

TASK-S20-12: Carried from S19's second review into the dense panels (docs/design/workspace.md 0; docs/slices/S19-review-2.md): the scroll bar's width reserved so a row is as wide with it as without (minor 10: material densities cut), a uniform body's Material reading Uniform (11), the Probe's reading out of the figure and into the right panel or status line (13), one unit a column in Readings, and the review's list What S20 will have to shrink (theme::HIT and the tests that encode 24 pt) (done)
TASK-S20-13: S20's brief (docs/slices/S20.md), the task split and the S20 and S22 rows of REBUILD 9 (done)
TASK-S20-14: S20's record: the demo and its pictures against S19's, the validation report against s19-editor-second-half, ARCHITECTURE, the recipes, PROGRESS (done)
TASK-S20-15: S20 review fixes: the room keeps the camera in, not out; the wheel's speed while walking; no Ctrl sprint and a leave-site guard on the web; Home's undo by label; the minors (done)
TASK-S21-01: Per-vertex ambient occlusion baked into the greedy meshes (merge only on equal AO) and the same AO at the far march's hit (not started)
TASK-S21-02: Sun and sky light in linear light, a neutral tone curve and distance fog to the sky colour (not started)
TASK-S21-03: Sun shadows: one ray per pixel through a camera-centred coarse occupancy volume, capped per frame (measure first) (not started)
TASK-S21-04: Sky: an analytic gradient now; a scattering atmosphere (Hillaire 2020) with the planet world (not started)
TASK-S21-05: Voxel colour: cell-hash lightness jitter and height/slope blends per material, computed at draw time (not started)
TASK-S21-06: Looks as data: a beauty look and a data look (identity on colour maps), switchable, with a badge when lighting shifts colours (not started)

TASK-S19-02: Pop-out windows (native, egui viewports), keeping each panel's place in the Tab order (moved to S20 by the S19 brief; floating in-page panels are TASK-S19-01's) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S19-03: The Scale tool: handles on the selection, a typed factor, one edit (re-titled by the S19 brief; Rotate is TASK-S20-01) (moved to S20 by the S19 record: the panels redesign came first) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)
TASK-S19-05: Camera follow, pointer lock (native and web) and the trackball (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S19-06: Detail tiers: a numerics block in the scene, tier files (preview, standard, reference) measured against the reference, progressive refinement and the footer switch (moved to S20 by the S19 record: the panels redesign came first) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)
TASK-S19-07: Multi-selection and grouped edits: Select as a set, box select, multi-drag, reorder and templates as one undo step (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S19-08: Units typed with values (2 km, 45 deg) in fields, sessions and the console (moved to S20 by the S19 record: the panels redesign came first) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S19-10: Camera bookmarks in the scene: view save, goto, drop; , and . step through them; the header's list (S18's C6) (moved to S20 by the S19 record: the panels redesign came first) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S19-11: The browser's reserved keys: a web chord for every action on one, on the ? sheet and in the palette in the page (moved to S20 by the S19 record: the panels redesign came first) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S19-14: Phones and tablets in the web build (owner, 25 Nov 2026): touch (tap, one-finger orbit, two-finger pan and pinch, long-press menu, finger-sized handles), drawers and a bottom tool bar on narrow screens, 44 pt targets, nothing hover-only, Safari's WebGPU and memory; screenshots at 390x844, 1024x1366, 1366x1024 (moved to S20 by the S19 brief: S19 is full) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S19-20: Measure, the Slice handle in the view and the voxel Paint brush (split from TASK-S19-04) (moved to S20 by the S19 record: the panels redesign came first) (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)

TASK-S20-01: Rotate: an orientation for bodies (the read turns the arm points into the body's frame), the ring gizmo, typed angles (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)
TASK-S20-02: A user keymap file merged over ui/actions.ron's keys, refused with its line when it clashes (moved to S22 by the S20 brief: the workspace came first) (not started)
TASK-S22-01: A live mode: time keeps running and the signal, periodogram and timeline show a rolling window, bounded in memory (split from TASK-S20-09 by the S20 brief) (not started)

TASK-S22-02: World-editing brushes at scale - raise, dig, smooth, flatten, paint and place-a-prefab along a stroke, over 10^6 cells as one undoable edit written as S25's saved-world delta (TASK-S24-07), the summaries updated along the edit's path; oracles: the stroke reloads the same bytes, mass changes by exactly what was added or dug, the gravity read unchanged within its ledger outside the stroke (not started)

g.text: S23 — The read on the GPUThe read on the GPU

rect.title: TASK-S5-01: GPU tree walk with float-float accumulation and parity tests (moved to S23 by the S5 brief) (not started)
TASK-S5-02: Local frames and differential evaluation (precision-far scene) (moved to S23 by the S5 brief) (not started)
TASK-S5-05: Live read: preview then refine, frame-budget scheduler (moved to S23 by the S5 brief) (not started)
TASK-S24-01: The S24 brief (docs/slices/S24.md) from docs/research/worlds.md: scope, criteria written before measuring, the task split (not started)

TASK-S24-08: Mass-consistent LOD from the generator - octaves made mass- and dipole-preserving on aligned blocks (docs/research/worlds.md 3), a coarse node generated straight from the recipe with exact mass and horizontal first moments and its vertical and higher moments within a stated bound carried into the ledger as a generation line; the walk opens a node whose line is too big and the generator makes its children; level-0 columns carry their exact column integral as partial fill; oracles: generated node = summed children (mass <= 1e-12, first moments <= 1e-12), bound >= measured residual, control: plain fBm misses mass by >= 1e-6 (not started)

TASK-S24-09: The Minecraft-style generator - fBm, ridged and billow octaves, domain warp, biomes from climate noise (temperature, humidity, continentalness, erosion, weirdness) with real-density strata, 3-D density for overhangs and caves (cheese, spaghetti and noodle in the Minecraft sense), rivers and lakes, a mass-conserving erosion stage computed per region tile with a halo, settlement placement with procedural buildings and roads; each stage data in the recipe; the stages' speed per chunk recorded (not started)

TASK-S24-10: Infinite flat worlds - the plane base with generated departures over an unbounded key space, the read's horizon and the tail bound 2 pi G sigma / R with sigma from the recipe's amplitude bound in the ledger; oracles: an empty plane reads zero gradient, a generated plateau converges to the Bouguer slab, the tail bound >= the measured change as the horizon grows (not started)

TASK-S24-11: Planets - a cube-sphere surface (TASK-S24-04's tiles) generating a crust of departures on the layered sphere, local frames on the CPU, drawn from orbit to the surface and read; oracles: an empty planet = its layers, a generated hill on a planet against the same hill on the plane falls as 1/R, no seam across a face edge (bit-equal shared faces) (not started)

TASK-S24-12: Prefabs and instancing - a prefab (a body or a set of world pieces) placed many times by the recipe or by hand: one tree and its moments shared, many poses; deduplicated chunks; oracles: an instance reads as the same body placed alone bit for bit, mass of n instances = n times one (not started)

TASK-S24-13: Generated terrain against terrain corrections - the same column heights as an independent prism sum (Nagy prisms in the oracle, Harmonica's prism_layer as a cross-check in a script) at >= 8 tower positions within the ledger at 1e-6 rad; Hammer-zone and Bouguer checks; the gravity read unchanged within its ledger on every S5 scene (not started)

TASK-S24-14: S24's record: the demo (a seeded Minecraft-style world, an infinite plane, a planet from orbit), the validation report against the previous tag, ARCHITECTURE, a recipe for a new world layer (docs/extending/a-world-layer.md), PROGRESS (not started)

g.text: S25 — Speed: the engine coreSpeed: the engine core

rect.title: TASK-S24-02: Planet-ready keys - 64-bit chunk and octree keys (level plus 3 x 21-bit or wider signed coordinates, or an i64 triple), region files and caches keyed by them, the old i32 ChunkKey read and converted; a key at the planet's edge round-trips; control: an i32 key overflows at 6.4e6 m and 1 cm (docs/research/worlds.md 7) (not started)

TASK-S24-03: f64 world positions with local frames for the render and the read, audited - every chunk origin and node centre from integer keys times a dyadic pitch, every GPU number an offset formed in f64 on the CPU; precision-far grows to 1e7 m on the CPU: town reads and draws the same there as at the origin (S23 ports it to the GPU) (not started)

TASK-S24-04: Chunk addressing that can wrap a cube-sphere - a 64-bit surface tile key (face, level, i, j) beside the Cartesian chunk key, the map from a tile to the chunks under it and back, neighbours across face edges; the plane is the one-face case; generation, streaming and caches keyed by it (docs/research/worlds.md 7) (not started)

TASK-S24-05: The recipe format and deterministic chunk generation - a world as layers written as data (base, shape, strata, features, structures, detail, edits), versioned and hashed; chunk = f(seed, recipe hash, key) on integer cell coordinates; integer-hash noise (pcg3d) and only IEEE basic operations, with a lint refusing platform transcendentals in generators; today's Terrain ported as its first layer (its sin replaced); oracles: the same bytes on 1, 2, 6 threads and in the page, every shared face of neighbours bit-equal, controls: chunk-local float coordinates and a sin call (docs/research/worlds.md 2, 4) (not started)

TASK-S24-06: A compressed chunk format - palette, leaves and exact-skin side tables packed (bit-packed palette indices, run lengths over Morton order, then a general compressor if one earns its place), versioned, every count checked before it is reserved; round-trip to the bit, ratio and speed recorded on town and a noise terrain (not started)

TASK-S24-07: Saved worlds as recipe + sparse edit delta - a world file is its recipe, seed and the chunks that differ from what the recipe makes (as compressed chunks, or as per-cell deltas when small); loading regenerates and applies; the delta is canonical (same edits in any order, same bytes); oracles: reload = the edited world bit for bit, an unedited world saves as its recipe alone, delta size proportional to the edit (not started)
TASK-S25-01: S25's brief from docs/research/performance-plan.md: the exits as speed-ups on the build PC against the S5 tag, web budgets, the read unchanged within its ledger (not started)
TASK-S25-02: Profiling kept: the sampling profiler as cargo xtask profile, the flythrough with the gravity read held off and beside it, a 600-frame town baseline with GPU timestamps (not started)

TASK-S25-03: The engine keeps the world's octree, the opened chunks' trees and each tower's world read by the world's hash; the playhead reading composed from it (each chunk voxelised once) (not started)
TASK-S25-04: The octree updated on edit: the chunks an edited piece reaches and their ancestors made again, equal to a fresh build bit for bit (not started)
TASK-S25-05: The cube series in the cubic invariants (exact rational coefficients), within 1e-15 of the monopole; the oracle within its tolerances (not started)
TASK-S25-06: The near leaves' cost: the error-bounded split (17 to 68 us a call within 6.7 cells) measured by depth and bounded by the read's budget (not started)
TASK-S25-07: Each leaf's series order from the read's budget, its truncation bound in the ledger (W2 and W3 unchanged) (not started)
TASK-S25-08: One pool of threads for the read: no thread made per flight node, towers walked and read in parallel, the same bits on any count (not started)
TASK-S25-09: The read's leaves as arrays by regime (series, split, prism), the series loop vectorised; the walk's nodes in Morton order (not started)
TASK-S25-10: Chunks made and meshed off the frame natively (the hand-in budgeted), the handover's stand-ins kept; streaming and meshing p99 recorded (not started)
TASK-S25-11: The world drawn from one buffer: 8-byte quads pulled in the vertex shader, one compacted indirect draw, persistent buffers and bind groups (not started)
TASK-S25-12: Render LOD and read LOD from one cut description, switched within a frame of the data being there (not started)
TASK-S25-13: The shared voxel ray query (brick occupancy bits, the octree's masks above, a hierarchical DDA) for picking the world and bodies and for the walk camera (not started)

TASK-S25-14: Saving off the frame: region files and TASK-S24-06's compressed chunks written behind the frame, an unchanged region not rewritten; no frame past the flythrough's p99 while saving (not started)
TASK-S25-15: S25's record: the measurements against the S5 tag, the validation report, ARCHITECTURE, PROGRESS (not started)

TASK-S25-16: L1 at 1e-6 rad, carried from S5 (the owner's ruling of 28 Nov 2026, docs/slices/S5.md 7.9): town's tower 1 reads 688,799 leaves one by one, 4.8x fewer than the opened chunks' 3,284,512, missing L1's 10x; the read-speed tasks (06, 07, 09) take it on: at least 10x fewer at 1e-6, settled, W2 and W3 unchanged (not started)

g.text: S26 — Worlds: the EarthWorlds: the Earth

rect.title: TASK-S26-01: The S26 brief (docs/slices/S26.md): Worlds - the Earth; sources, licences and credits from docs/research/worlds.md 6 (not started)

TASK-S26-02: The Earth-data pipeline and an offline tile cache - range reads of cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs (Copernicus GLO-30 via a CORS-enabled mirror, the EA LiDAR WCS, ETOPO and GEBCO), terrarium PNG tiles, PMTiles; datums to one vertical reference (EGM2008 or ODN, said); a content-addressed cache outside the repo that works with the network off; the page's cache in browser storage, said (not started)

TASK-S26-03: Mean-preserving upsampling of elevation data - a smooth interpolant whose mean over each data cell is the datum (area-to-point, Kyriakidis 2004; Tobler 1979) plus mass- and dipole-preserving fractal detail; oracles: each data cell's mean <= 1e-12 relative, control: unconstrained detail moves it (not started)

TASK-S26-04: OSM buildings and roads - footprints, height, levels, min_height and roof shapes (Simple 3D Buildings), Overture where OSM is thin, extruded with floors and walls of plausible density and a stated default storey height; roads, rail and water as features; oracles: a building's mass = its floors and walls by construction, a footprint with a hole keeps it (not started)

TASK-S26-05: Land cover, geology and densities - ESA WorldCover classes to surface materials, BGS Geology and Macrostrat units to strata with densities from a cited table, uncertainty kept as a range; oracles: every class and unit mapped or said unmapped (not started)

TASK-S26-06: The real AION-10 site from data - Oxford's terrain, buildings and geology around the array; its terrain read against an independent prism sum of the DEM within the ledger; its terrain effect beside BGS's published gravity recorded, not gated (not started)

TASK-S26-07: A credits file and in-app attribution - every source with its licence, link and credit line (share-alike terms noted for information), the sources in use named on screen and in bundles (not started)
TASK-S26-08: S26's record: the demo, the validation report against the previous tag, ARCHITECTURE, PROGRESS (not started)
TASK-S27-01: The S27 brief (docs/slices/S27.md): Space - its research note first (orbits, frames, harmonics, the orbiting gradiometer) (not started)

TASK-S27-02: Orbits on rails - Kepler propagation and patched conics with time warp; oracles: an orbit returns to its start <= 1e-12 after 1e4 orbits, the same bits at every warp rate, hand-overs continuous (not started)
TASK-S27-03: N-body propagation and the ephemeris - an integrator for close approaches, against a published ephemeris within its stated error (not started)
TASK-S27-04: A floating origin and frames from planet-centred to local, for the render, the dynamics and the read; the same phase and motion at the origin and 1e8 m away (not started)
TASK-S27-05: Worlds planets from orbit down to voxels - S24's planets streamed and drawn across the whole range of scale, the read's rings to the coarsest node (not started)
TASK-S27-06: Rigid spacecraft - S7's bodies in orbit, docking and contact with the ground (not started)
